text:
maria-partners: Quick kickoff — AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace listing onboarding. Need to confirm KMS key flow for trial images, retention policy, and legal approvals. Who's on this?

sam-legal: @maria-partners I can take legal review. main things: terms for trial, data processing addendum, and marketing snapshot consent. Need the packaging copy and a sample trial SKU ID.

raj-product: I'm on packaging. Current plan: single-image AMI/GCP image per cloud, 14-day trial entitlement, and a free-tier li mited seat. We need to confirm image retention & logs policy so ops can size buckets.

elaine-ops: For retention: default imagery artifacts (AMIs/container layers/snapshots) we keep 30 days after publish. Audit copies for compliance kept 1 year. But marketplaces sometimes require 90-day artifact availability — which vendor?

nate-cloud: AWS asks for AMI permissions and an S3 bucket with lifecycle rules. GCP has a similar registry policy. Azure wants SAS tokens and storage account retention. Also KMS: they need us to support customer-managed keys for Private offers, or at minimum envelope encryption with our KMS.

maria-partners: @nate-cloud good note. Priority 1: define KMS model. For Private/Dedicated customers we must support importing a key or using their KMS. For public listing, we can use Redwood-managed keys but document in privacy.

sam-legal: Can you add that to the legal checklist: "KMS models (customer-managed vs provider) + mapping in SLA", and a snippet for the DPA? I can draft. Also need to validate our retention language aligns with marketplaces' listing policy.

raj-product: Action item: I'll produce a short packaging spec and sample asset manifest by EOD tomorrow. It will include AMI/GCP image IDs placeholders, expected disk size, and a minimal startup script.

elaine-ops: Ops needs: 1) required IAM roles (publish, image-share), 2) bucket lifecycle example, 3) test signing key used to sign images. Can raj include IAM role STS names and a minimal `cloud-iam.yaml` snippet?

raj-product: Yes. Example snippet: ```yaml
roles:
  - name: marketplace-publisher
    actions: [ec2:RegisterImage, s3:PutObject, iam:PassRole]
```

listing-bot: deploy-trigger: marketplace-packaging-draft created by raj-product at 1769000123

maria-partners: Also need marketing assets: 2 screenshots, 1 quickstart guide, and a 30s demo video. Any compliance flags on the demo?

sam-legal: Demo must not show customer data. Add a one-line in the TOC: "redwood-demo uses synthetic data only". I'll draft the legal blurb.

nate-cloud: Re KMS: for AWS Private offers we support Bring-Your-Own-Key via AWS KMS key ARN — we'll need a handshake for key policy. For GCP/Azure we support CMEK binding; ops to provide binding docs.

elaine-ops: I'll draft the binding runbook. On retention: marketplaces may force us to keep snapshots available for 90 days for rollbacks. I'll set lifecycle to 120 days to be safe.

maria-partners: Great. Who will own the vendor submission checklist? I can drive but want input.

raj-product: I'll own packaging artifacts and manifest.

sam-legal: I'll own legal checklist and DPA items.

elaine-ops: Ops owns infra/runbooks and KMS integration testing.

nate-cloud: I'll do cloud-specific offer steps (AWS AMI sharing, GCP image family creation, Azure marketplace publisher portal steps).

maria-partners: Timeline: soft launch to staging marketplaces in 2 weeks. Milestones: packaging spec (raj) 48h, legal draft (sam) 72h, ops runbook (elaine) 5 days, cloud steps (nate) 5 days, marketing assets 7 days. Can everyone confirm?

raj-product: Confirmed.

sam-legal: Confirmed.

elaine-ops: Confirmed.

nate-cloud: Confirmed.

maria-partners: OK — I'll create a shared checklist and invite the contacts from each marketplace. Also: include a short risk register: billing metadata mismatch, trial entitlement misconfiguration, image size > limit, and KMS handshake failure.

raj-product: Noted: trial entitlement mapping to internal license keys — will include sample JWT claim schema.

sam-legal: Also flag: export control for some crypto libs in the image. I'll run a quick scan.

maria-partners: Thanks. I'll follow up with the checklist link in ~30m. If any blockers pop up ping me @maria-partners. :rocket:

listing-bot: reminder: marketplace-checklist created at 1769000360 by maria-partners

elaine-ops: Quick question — for the sample startup script can we bake in an environment var that toggles telemetry off for marketplaces? We should not collect beyond allowed telemetry.

raj-product: Yes, add `REDWOOD_MARKETPLACE_TELEMETRY=false` and document it in quickstart.

sam-legal: Perfect. That should satisfy privacy reviewers.

maria-partners: End thread: thanks everyone, will DM follow-ups.
